subtitle: Design Project III(Sato Kouichi)
teachers:
SATO Kouichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is for students to acquire the knowledge and ability for the following: students discover building production or building system design issues by themselves and develop a project theme based on those issues. Next, they analyze the structure of the problem, applying appropriate approaches, and propose a solution to the problem. Finally, students write papers on issues they have uncovered or create architectural designs that address those issues.
advice:
Students select a research theme among themes designated by the end of the third year, and take on the theme for the whole fourth year.
Students carry out research activities for more than two thousand minutes a week.
Students attend Sato Laboratory seminars twice a week, report the current state of their research, and receive advice on their work from the professor.
requiredKnowledge: Sato laboratory demands adult behavior, speech, and courtesy by students because they carry out research with cooperation from outside the school as well as inside.

activityGoals.body: Students can develop project themes by themselves, carry out the research on the themes based on research plans.
Students can present the results of their projects effectively within a given time.
Students can collect as much information as possible about the project theme, analyze it within a given time.
Students understand the positions of various professionals related to building production.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey based on an awareness of the project problem, and are able to explain not only the problem as a research theme related to building production but also the necessity of solving it. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves, and effectively carry out the project according to their plan. They can produce a logical report of the results and give an effective presentation of the findings to others.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain their own awareness of the issues and collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves and carry out the project. They can create a report of the results and give a presentation of their findings for others.

              学習・教育目標

              1.Building production/building system design
2.Building materials and components
3.Fireproof wooden considerations
4.Finance
5.Renovation

              The aim of this course is for students to acquire the knowledge and ability for the following: students discover building production or building system design issues by themselves and develop a project theme based on those issues. Next, they analyze the structure of the problem, applying appropriate approaches, and propose a solution to the problem. Finally, students write papers on issues they have uncovered or create architectural designs that address those issues.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students select a research theme among themes designated by the end of the third year, and take on the theme for the whole fourth year.
Students carry out research activities for more than two thousand minutes a week.
Students attend Sato Laboratory seminars twice a week, report the current state of their research, and receive advice on their work from the professor.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

               　　　

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Sato laboratory demands adult behavior, speech, and courtesy by students because they carry out research with cooperation from outside the school as well as inside.
